name: code-chat-file-links
about: Three leftovers of a Code chat's files and summary (16 Nov 2026), on a real model: a file link's ⋯ (ui/fileLinks.js: it comes up on a hover, its menu the right-click's, Open in Yap from it); an Outputs row that opens where Settings → Yap Code's "Open file links in" says (outputsOpen.js: VS Code there — test mode keeps the command, `state`'s filesOpened — and a .js file under Windows' default app shown in Yap instead, as #147's links); and the summary's Changes on a real pull request of Yap's own with cancelled checks (agents/prs.rs: "Checks cancelled · 8 of 10 passed", never "Checks failing"), through the lab's read-only gh on branch claude/lab-untested (#146: two cancelled E2E shards, CodeQL's neutral). Needs a live lab, Yap Code, and an editor the test Yap finds (YAP_LAB_EDITORS, or this PC's).

steps.note: A branch of Yap's own repository whose pull request (#146) has two cancelled checks.

steps.ask: Add a function toFeet(cm) to src/convert.js that returns cm / 30.48. Then say in one short sentence which file you changed, writing its path as inline code.

steps.note: The path in the answer is a link to the workspace's file.
The pointer on the link: its ⋯ comes up at its end.
A click on the ⋯: the link's own menu, under it.
Open in Yap, Open in <editor> (when one is found), Show in folder, Copy path.
Open in Yap from the ⋯'s menu: the file view beside the chat.
Links open in VS Code now.
#146's cancelled E2E shards: cancelled, as GitHub says it, not failing.
The changed file's Outputs row, with links opening in VS Code: VS Code (test mode keeps the command), not Yap's view.
Its menu: Open (VS Code), Open in Yap, Show in folder, Copy path, Open in VS Code.
Windows' default app: convert.js is a script it would run.
Shown in Yap instead, said so — never run.
